analysis:
Reviewed all four primary analyses against the canonical index, supplied T-041 definition and available source replay. No independently supported regression is established. The replay verifies documentation changes, not all implementation claims; 12 reviewed source units are omitted.
changelog.d/provider-addon-hold-hardening.md:3–15 and docs/architecture/addon-hold.md HEAD patch lines 40–45, 70–74 and 87–96 describe hold-aware load/publication fencing, release-safe cancellation, preservation of startup model records, accept-time signer verification and bounded/nonblocking control reads. docs/architecture/inference.md:2555 adds the corresponding retryable 503 explanation; README.md:25 only adds a link. These changes primarily concern A-018, TB-012/T-059 and TB-007/T-010. No supplied change demonstrates weakened encryption, cache-account isolation, weight verification, billing or App Attest authorization. Historical residual risks are not new findings.
Material contracts remain unresolved: ProviderLoop+AddonHold.swift must preserve drain snapshot identity across release/re-hold and retire local requests before unload; waiting beyond the documented 60-second settle allowance must remain release/stop-responsive. The ModelLoading analysis reports HEAD fences at 397, 577, 711 and 945, but executable replay is absent. Verify those checks together with native MiMo/Super publication and StartupPreload.persistLoadedModelSet, including the newly unconditional persistence call reported at 1203. Verify AddonIPCServer signer checks precede slot allocation, and AddonHoldStore/AddonHoldControl refuse blocking file types. HEAD threat-model TB-012/T-059 and the added threat definition are also absent, preventing validation of the mailbox and persistence-failure coverage. Coordinator busy-field handling remains an external contract. These are evidence limits requiring further review, not observed missing controls.
